threads.body: [Testing] `hasAttributesSatisfying` silently permits unexpected attributes, so this regression test would not detect accidental extra server-span attributes from the new propagation path. Assert the complete expected server-span attribute set with `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)`.

replies.body:
Addressed in edb64868309e85556edc56f911cda36047c99092.

Analysis: The regression test checked only `client.address`, so it accepted any extra attributes on the server span. The test now uses `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)` for the full expected HTTP, URL, server, client, and network attribute set. It also verifies the span name, kind, and parent.

Upsides: The test now detects unwanted attributes from the remote-address propagation path and documents the complete expected server span.

Downsides: The test must be updated when the expected Akka HTTP server span attributes change.
